diagnostic_type: MC Default measured source-boundary and protocol-schedule replay

protocol.source: Powertech Labs SAE J2601 MC Default bench traces
protocol.raw_archive: data/public_validation/raw/h2protocol_mc_default/SAE J2601 MC Default Bench Test Data.zip

interpretation.finding: Measured source-pressure replay improves pressure agreement in some configurations, but no run satisfies the joint pressure, temperature and final-SOC screen across the eight consumed cases.
interpretation.structural_evidence: Source-boundary choice is material, yet source-pressure replay alone does not identify the current station topology, controller/dispatch behavior, thermal boundary or vehicle-tank representation.
interpretation.negative_control: Increasing the gas-temperature stop sensitivity from 95 C to 200 C raises coverage but does not improve the joint screen; the safety limit must not be tuned to manufacture agreement.
interpretation.screening_summary: Best run passes 1/8 cases; the protocol-profile run has pressure RMSE below 5 MPa but temperature and SOC remain above their limits.
interpretation.claim_boundary: This post-outcome development diagnostic cannot be promoted to independent external full-loop validation, cannot modify the frozen MC Default holdout result, and cannot support an IJHE full digital-twin performance or field-safety claim.

validation_boundary.next_required_protocol: Pre-register an independent measured-boundary evaluation with synchronized source pressure, source/inlet temperature, dispenser flow, vehicle pressure and SOC, plus station topology and valve-state logs before scoring.
required_external_evidence: written reuse rights and immutable file hashes
independent expert review and SAGA effectiveness/safety study
